answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus secures agent economies by requiring nodes to bond native assets, acting as a virtual copper wire connecting identity to financial risk. Like a lantern illuminating hidden actors, staking forces attackers to lock significant capital, rendering the juniper of Sybil proliferation prohibitively expensive. An adversary must acquire a majority of staked value to subvert the network, ensuring the cost of malicious activity outweighs potential gains through systemic economic loss.
